items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Who got you to make that record? Who got you to make the record? Larry Burstead.

ctx.x: I don't know. How did you build this band? This banjo, this man played bass on, I had another guitar, but I had one that didn't but it was a smaller guitar than that. He seconded me on the bass, on the bass field. He seconded me playing, and I played bass on that field. You know, playing. You can play my guitar or anything that I played on guitar or anything. It was just a trumpet.

Who got you to make that record? Who got you to make the record? Larry Burstead. Yeah. It was a while back. Where did you get to travel to? Did you ever go into Texas or up to Tennessee? I worked, what do you say now? Did you ever go to Texas? No. Tennessee, just Mississippi and Louisiana? No.

Ever been to Mississippi? I mean to Memphis? No. Never been to Memphis. Birmingham? No. North Carolina, South Carolina? No. Not really. Not really. Did you ever hear any uh, piano players that really play the blues? Yeah, I have heard
